evals.prompt: I want to create a Zed extension for the Supabase MCP server at https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp. It requires an API key passed as a query parameter ?token=KEY. Can you build it?
evals.expected_output: A complete Zed MCP extension with all files following the mcp-remote bridge pattern, passing the token as a query parameter in the URL instead of a header

evals.prompt: Help me build a Zed editor extension that connects to the Firecrawl MCP server at https://api.firecrawl.dev/mcp. Authentication is via Authorization: Bearer header. The extension should be called firecrawl-mcp.
evals.expected_output: A complete Zed MCP extension using the mcp-remote bridge pattern with auth header, correct API usage, settings preservation, and all supporting files

evals.prompt: I have a custom MCP server running at https://mycompany.internal/mcp/v1 that requires both an API key header and a team-id header. How do I create a Zed extension for it with two settings fields?
evals.expected_output: A Zed MCP extension with two settings fields (api_key and team_id), both passed as headers to mcp-remote, with settings preservation for both fields
